note: T-16 PASSES the 7-sigma gate on the current cells: pooled over the 45-corner grid mean -0.7 ps, sigma 3.4 ps, sigma-to-spec 8.6 with lower confidence bound 8.3 against 7; no draw falls outside +-30 ps. Supersedes the failing 2026-11-10 record (mean +16.6 ps, sigma 6.6 ps, 3.6 % outside +-30 ps, worst 37.1 ps), which predates the TX predriver NOR widening (89d803b, PR #164) and the aib_pad_esd XResd l=1u shortening (e47bb80, PR #332); both changes target exactly the rise/fall asymmetry that carried the old mean.
